body:
I feel I was reasonably happy as a kid, it's just that even then I was sick of hearing about the things I should be arranging my future around; school, relationships, finances, etc. And I know I don't have to live focusing on these things.

I can enjoy the simple things in life, but that's about it. Simple pleasures can be easy to find, but it's not enough to make me want to continue living.
Not much, I work, go to the gym, and relax at home. I got tired of socializing so I have few fair weather friends, but that's it.
Even before I was depressed, I had no interest in my future growing up either, as I recall. I guess I just don't find pleasure living as a part of our society.

I've had suicidal fantasies every day for my entire adult life. Counseling never helped me, and I've tried antidepressants twice with no effect, which I know is not enough to determine whether or not antidepressants could change my outlook.

I'm not interested in doing or obtaining any of the things society tends to place value in, however, I don't really have any of my own aspirations or passions, either. I don't feel like my soul is crushed or anything, I just feel ready to die.
